rootIntakeConcerns: expectedFence is optional; pre-read does not bind the coordinator to its observed fence when null.
Separate pre/post lineage checks leave a read/replay race; the codec passed to coordinator is not lineage-scoped.
Optional injected DurableCommandCoordinator may use a different store from the direct lineage precheck.
Pre-read/resolve/reread casts and exceptions omit valid cancelled variants; resolve outcome ignored and reads duplicated.
Outcome metadata is borrowed mutable state; equality ignores metadata.
Command snapshots and canonical identities use caller input separately; return Iterable enumerated more than once; canonicalization conflates BigInt and String.
Canonical payload identity advertised bounded, but constructors do not visibly enforce a byte/depth/scalar boundary.
Sale gross += differs from SaleProposal binary64 sum profile; receipt number override can disagree with persisted sale number.
Existing original sale posting eligibility is association-based; assess actual source/journal/receipt/date reconciliation before return or void.
